question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_desc = '2020-04' THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) >= 1.2 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_desc = '2019-04' THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END)
),
city_product_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_desc = '2019-04' THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS sales_q4_2019,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_desc = '2020-04' THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS sales_q4_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON c.cust_city = qc.cust_city
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p WHERE p.prod_id = s.prod_id)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(sales_q4_2019) AS total_q4_2019,
        SUM(sales_q4_2020) AS total_q4_2020
    FROM city_product_sales
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT cps.prod_id,
           cps.sales_q4_2019,
           cps.sales_q4_2020,
           NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY (cps.sales_q4_2019 + cps.sales_q4_2020) DESC) AS quintile
    FROM city_product_sales cps
)
SELECT 
    p.prod_name,
    ROUND(rp.sales_q4_2019 * 1.0 / ts.total_q4_2019, 6) AS share_q4_2019,
    ROUND(rp.sales_q4_2020 * 1.0 / ts.total_q4_2020, 6) AS share_q4_2020,
    ROUND((rp.sales_q4_2020 * 1.0 / ts.total_q4_2020) - (rp.sales_q4_2019 * 1.0 / ts.total_q4_2019), 6) AS share_diff
FROM ranked_products rp
JOIN products p ON rp.prod_id = p.prod_id
CROSS JOIN total_sales ts
WHERE rp.quintile = 1
ORDER BY share_diff DESC
